prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end luxury fashion editorial photograph for a Parisian haute-couture Valentine's Day campaign. A clearly adult woman sits on an ornate antique French Louis XV style gilded armchair, body positioned at a three-quarter angle with her back toward the camera, torso elegantly turned while looking back over her right shoulder toward the camera in a classic over-the-shoulder pose. She sits on the edge of the cushion with legs crossed at the knees and maintains a graceful poised posture. She has medium-length chocolate-brown hair in soft loose romantic waves, a warm luminous complexion, natural brows, warm brown smoky eyeshadow, subtle champagne shimmer, black mascara, nude-mauve satin lips and delicate crystal drop earrings. She wears an elegant red silk satin slip dress with delicate straps and a tasteful open-back couture design, smooth bias-cut drape, black semi-transparent hosiery and fine gold jewelry chains arranged across the back as decorative couture accessories. Set the scene in an opulent Parisian palace interior with French Rococo and Baroque decor, framed panels, drapery, gilded furniture and a burgundy rose arrangement. Use soft warm editorial light, realistic satin reflections, refined jewelry detail, shallow depth of field and premium fashion-advertisement quality. Preserve the source over-shoulder pose, red dress, armchair, jewelry and romantic Parisian concept while keeping the adult fashion framing non-explicit.
